title: GTFS Scorecard workspace history record
description: One line of DIR/<feed>/history.jsonl, written by `scorecard try --history DIR` and read by `scorecard trend --history DIR` (#362). Counts and codes only: no finding text, no feed contact fields, and a local feed is named by its file name. This schema describes version 1.0. Within 1.x fields are only added, and readers ignore fields they do not know.

name.description: The feed's display name, from --name or the feed's host or file name.

source.description: The feed URL as given, or `local file <name>` for a local zip.

date.description: The snapshot date the run scored the feed under.

categories.description: Score of each measured category. An unmeasured category is absent, never zero.

findings.description: Finding codes and their instance counts across the measured categories.

freshness.description: The freshness facts the expiry alert reads.
